thesisQuality.note: Broad industrial machine-vision need, 30,000+ customers and expanding AI product adoption support durable demand, while substitution and undisclosed attach economics prevent exceptional treatment.

financialOperatingMomentum.note: Q2 revenue +17% YoY, gross margin 70.6%, operating margin 29.4%, strong cash generation, $755m cash/investments and no debt demonstrate broad operating acceleration and funding resilience.

marketValuationOpportunity.note: September 18 market data show $61.56 share price, about $10.36b market cap, 59.2x trailing P/E and 34.32x forward P/E after a large re-rating, leaving demanding rather than compelling valuation headroom.

catalystScore.note: Full-year guidance for strong double-digit growth plus OneVision general availability and hundreds of users provide multiple identifiable operating catalysts, tempered by adoption economics not yet disclosed.

governancePower.note: Cost discipline, margin expansion, cash generation, dividend and debt-free balance sheet support competent capital allocation; evidence does not justify exceptional long-duration stewardship.

alignment2036.note: Machine vision and edge AI directly enable manufacturing and distribution automation, quality and throughput across durable industrial needs.

crossDivisionLeverage.note: Core vision capability serves logistics, electronics, automotive, packaging and semiconductor markets, though four large end markets represented about 85% of 2025 revenue.

bottleneckControl.note: Cognex has meaningful installed capability and integration know-how, but disclosed competition from vendors, integrators, customer engineering and open-source AI prevents a strong scarcity-control score.

scenarioRobustness.note: Broad customer base, geographic reach, cash reserves and multiple industrial end markets support resilience, offset by synchronized industrial-capex and end-market concentration risk.

substitutionResilience.note: AI vision performance and deployment simplicity create differentiation, but credible vendor, integrator, internal-engineering and open-source substitutes remain.

supplyChainResilience.note: Strong liquidity and current profitable operations provide buffer against supply disruptions; historical component constraints and lack of evidence for exceptional tested redundancy cap the score.

pricingPower.note: 70.6% Q2 gross margin and substantial operating leverage support meaningful value capture, while direct evidence of contractual pass-through or durable scarcity rent is limited.

risk.note: Primary risks are industrial/end-market concentration, technological substitution and valuation sensitivity; balance-sheet failure risk is low because the company has substantial liquidity and no debt.

confidence.note: Core operating, balance-sheet, competition and identity evidence comes from recent SEC filings; valuation is independently current, while product adoption economics remain issuer-origin and partially undisclosed.

thesis: Cognex is a financially strong industrial machine-vision leader benefiting from durable automation and edge-AI demand, with improving operating leverage; the thesis is constrained by substitution, end-market concentration and a demanding valuation.
keyRisk: Premium valuation plus credible machine-vision/AI substitutes could compress returns if current growth and margin momentum fades.
nextCatalyst: Q3 2026 earnings and evidence that OneVision adoption converts into durable revenue, margins and multi-site deployment economics.

scoreBreakdown.note: earthScore is the weighted Methodology 1.0 component score; risk and confidence are separately supplied for runtime gate treatment.
